verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a POS system (shopify-docs-9, shopify-docs-26) and positions selling online and in person on one plan (shopify-docs-55), with orders from all sales channels in one place (shopify-docs-57). However, nothing in the evidence explicitly says the POS shares the same catalog, inventory, and customer records as the online store. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a shared product catalog, unified inventory sync between POS and online, a shared customer database, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
